# Online Store Sales Performance Snapshot

A compact view of revenue, orders, and ad spend from **2026-01 to 2026-06**. The dataset shows steady growth overall, with one small dip in May before a strong June rebound.

## Best Charts to Build

### 1) Monthly Revenue and Orders Trend
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/graph-up.svg
- Chart type: **Dual-axis line chart**
- X-axis: Month
- Left Y-axis: Revenue
- Right Y-axis: Orders
- Why it helps: Shows whether revenue growth is tracking order growth month by month.

### 2) Ad Spend vs Revenue Efficiency
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/bar-chart-line.svg
- Chart type: **Combo chart** or **scatter plot**
- X-axis: Ad Spend
- Y-axis: Revenue
- Add labels by month
- Why it helps: Reveals whether higher ad spend is translating into higher sales, and highlights efficiency changes.

## Sales Performance by Month

Month | Revenue | Orders | Ad Spend
2026-01 | 42,000 | 860 | 6,200
2026-02 | 45,500 | 910 | 6,800
2026-03 | 47,000 | 940 | 7,100
2026-04 | 51,200 | 1,010 | 7,600
2026-05 | 49,800 | 980 | 7,300
2026-06 | 53,800 | 1,080 | 8,100

## Main Insights

- **Revenue rose 28.1%** from January to June, from 42,000 to 53,800.
- **Orders rose 25.6%** over the same period, from 860 to 1,080.
- **Ad spend increased 30.6%**, which suggests growth was supported by higher marketing investment.
- **Revenue per order stayed fairly stable** overall, with a slight improvement by June.
- **April was the strongest month before June**, but May dipped slightly in both revenue and orders, then recovered strongly in June.

## Anomalies and Notable Patterns

- **May dip:** Revenue fell from 51,200 to 49,800 and orders dropped from 1,010 to 980 despite ad spend staying high at 7,300.
- **June rebound:** Revenue and orders both hit the period high, indicating the May slowdown was likely temporary.
- **Spend efficiency looks mixed:** Ad spend kept rising, but revenue did not rise perfectly in lockstep, so return on ad spend may be flattening in some months.
- **No major outlier spikes:** The series is smooth overall, which suggests stable business performance rather than one-off surges.
